definition: non_empty_output — the output must not be empty or whitespace-only: pass when output.trim().length > 0. docs/api-reference.md §Completeness Rules. Positive = empty or nothing visible (the rule should FAIL).
source: LLM-authored on 2026-09-04. Held out on 2026-09-23: the 6 case(s) copied from, varied from or modelled on the 24 real transcripts in tests/fixtures/real-transcripts (nonempty-024, nonempty-025, nonempty-026, nonempty-027, nonempty-028, nonempty-029) were removed, so no number this family publishes is estimated on a transcript, and the transcript line in proof/TRANSCRIPTS.md and proof/COMPOSITE.md is measured on cases none of these rates were estimated from. 1 replacement case(s), authored the same day and marked in their notes, bring the family back to the 24-case floor the runner enforces.
labelling: LLM-authored and LLM-labelled against the documented definition on 2026-09-04. Invisible-character cases (zero-width space, byte-order mark) are labelled positive because nothing is visible to a reader; the notes disclose where trim() disagrees.
